Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:10:1.hebrew: נאמרה שיתה למעלה - לענין דמי ולדות, "כאשר ישית עליו בעל האשה":
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:10:1.english: Imposing is stated above - Concerning compensation for fetuses: "as the husband of the woman shall impose upon him" (Exodus 21:22).

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:10:2.hebrew: ונאמרה שיתה למטה - במועד שהמית, אם כופר יושת עליו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:10:2.english: And imposing is stated below - [This is stated] with regard to a forewarned [ox] (mu'ad) that killed [a person]: "If a ransom shall be imposed upon him" [Exodus 21:30].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:14:1.hebrew: כיצד משלמין כופר - דבשלמא נזקין, האי פלגא משלם והאי פלגא משלם, דאהזיקא דניזק קפיד רחמנא, והאי מטי ליה נזק שלם. אבל כופרא כפרה דמזיק הוא, ותרוייהו כפרה בעו, ובחצי כופר לא מיכפר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:14:1.english: How do they pay [the] ransom - For it is well [regarding] damages, [where] this one pays half and that one pays half, because the Merciful One is concerned about the damage to the injured party, and this [injured party] receives full damages. However, ransom is an atonement for the damager, and both of them require atonement, and with half a ransom one is not atoned for.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:16:1.hebrew: ממשכנין אותו - גזבר הקדש, דכיון דלאו לכפרה אתי, משהי ליה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:16:1.english: They exact a pledge from him - The Temple treasurer [does so], for since it does not come for atonement, he delays [paying] it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:16:2.hebrew: חייבי חטאות אין ממשכנין אותן - דכיון לכפוריה חטאיה קבעי לה, לא משהי ליה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:16:2.english: Those liable for sin-offerings, we do not take a pledge from them - For since he wants it to atone for his sin, he does not delay it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:19:1.english: I am stuck on the first [question] - I have been shut in and silenced by the first [question].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:1:1.hebrew: אי לר"י - כלומר, אי כר"י סבירא ליה דאמר לקמן תם לא סגי ליה בשמירה פחותה, כגון דעבד ליה שמירה פחותה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:1:1.english: If [it is] according to Rabbi Yehuda - That is to say, if he holds like Rabbi Yehuda, who says later on [that for] a tam [innocuous ox], reduced safeguarding does not suffice for it, [it is speaking of a case] such as where he provided reduced safeguarding for it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:1:2.hebrew: אי לר"א בן יעקב - דאמר תם סגי ליה בשמירה פחותה, כגון דלא עבד ליה שמירה כלל. ואיצטריך לר' יעקב לאשמועינן דמעמידין אפוטרופוס לתם, ולהכי תנא ח"נ, ולא תנא רבי יעקב מחייב סתמא — דלא תימא במועד קמיירי וכולה נזקא קאמר, אבל בתם אפילו פלגא נזקא נמי לא, דאין מעמידין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:1:2.english: If [it is] according to Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov - Who says that for an innocuous [ox], reduced safeguarding is sufficient for it, [the case is] where he did not provide safeguarding for it at all. And it was necessary for Rabbi Yaakov to teach us that we appoint a steward for an innocuous [ox], and for this reason [the baraita] taught "half-damages" and did not teach "Rabbi Yaakov obligates [him]" without specification — so that you would not say that he is speaking of a forewarned [ox] and is stating [that he pays] full damages, whereas for an innocuous [ox], [he does] not [pay] even half-damages, because we do not appoint [a steward].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:20:1.english: And it was found [to be] forewarned - and it caused damage in the borrower's house.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:20:2.hebrew: בעלים משלמין ח"נ ושואל חצי נזק - דנטירותא דתם מיהא מקבל עליה, ובעלים, הואיל ולא הודיעוהו, משלמין החצי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:20:2.english: The owner pays half the damage and the borrower [pays] half the damage - For [the borrower] at any rate takes upon himself the guarding of an innocuous [ox], and the owner, since he did not inform him, pays the [other] half.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:21:1.hebrew: הועד בבית שואל - שהזיק בתוך ימי שאילתו ג' פעמים:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:21:1.english: Was rendered forewarned in the house of the borrower - [Meaning] that it caused damage during the days of its borrowing three times.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:21:2.hebrew: והחזירו לבעלים - ואח"כ הזיק, בעלים משלמין חצי נזק. לקמן מפרש טעמא, דקסבר רשות משנה, ופרכינן רישא לסיפא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:21:2.english: And he returned it to the owner - And afterwards it caused damage, the owner pays half-damage. Later, [the Gemara] explains the reason: that [the Tanna] holds [that a change of] domain alters [its status], and we challenge the first clause against the last clause.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:22:1.hebrew: אריא לא שאילי - נטירותא דאריא לא קבילית עלי, דאי תם הוה, לא הוה נגח:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:22:1.english: I did not borrow a lion - I did not accept upon myself the guarding of a lion, for if it had been innocuous, it would not have gored.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:23:1.hebrew: שהכיר בו שהוא נגחן - אבל לא ידע שנגח ג' נגיחות. הלכך, נטירותא [דתם] נגח קביל עליה והוה לי' לנטורי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:23:1.english: Where [the borrower] was aware that it was a goring [ox] - But he did not know that it had gored three times. Therefore, he accepted upon himself the guarding of a tam gorer, and he should have guarded [it].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:26:1.english: From its body - And not from mine.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:3:1.hebrew: א"ל חדא דאית ביה תרתי טעמא - הואיל וס"ל לרבא דלא פליגי ר' יעקב ור"י, בכולהו סבירא ליה הכי. ולהכי אוקמה רבא במועד ובשמירה פחותה, דתשמע מינה דאית ליה לר' יעקב כרבי יהודה — דסגי ליה לצד מועדת בשמירה פחותה, וצד תמות במקומה עומדת ולדידיה לא סגי ליה בשמירה פחותה — ותשמע נמי דמעמידין אפוטרופוס לתם לגבות מגופו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:3:1.english: He said to him: One [matter] containing two [elements of] reasoning - Since Rava holds that Rabbi Ya'akov and Rabbi Yehuda do not disagree, in all [respects] he [Rabbi Ya'akov] holds thus. And therefore Rava established [Rabbi Ya'akov's statement] as referring to a forewarned [ox] and with reduced safeguarding, so that you may infer from it that Rabbi Ya'akov holds like Rabbi Yehuda — that for the forewarned aspect, reduced safeguarding is sufficient for it, while the innocuous aspect remains in its [original] status, and for it reduced safeguarding is not sufficient — and you also infer that we appoint a guardian for an innocuous [ox] to collect from its body.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:4:1.hebrew: רשות משנה איכא בינייהו - בין רבי יעקב לר"י:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:4:1.english: [Whether] custody changes [its status] is [the difference] between them - Between Rabbi Yaakov and Rabbi Yehuda.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:4:2.hebrew: הרי הוא בחזקתו - שהועד בבית אפוטרופוס, ומשלמים בעלים נ"ש — החצי מגופו וחצי מעלייה, ככל תמים שהועדו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:4:2.english: It is in its [previous] status - For it was forewarned in the house of the steward, and the owners pay full damages — half from its body and half from superior [property], like all innocuous [oxen] that were forewarned.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:5:1.english: They pay from the superior-quality [property] - [For] damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:5:2.english: And they do not pay a ransom - Where [the ox] killed a person.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:9:1.hebrew: בדניזק שיימינן - בגופו של מת, ובהכי מכפר מזיק:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 40a:9:1.english: We evaluate according to the injured party - By [the value of] the body of the deceased, and thereby [the] damager atones.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:14:1.hebrew: שור של ב' שותפין - בשני שוורים של שנים לא מצי למיבעי, דלר"י בן בתירא, דאמר (סנהדרין דף עח.) בהכוהו עשרה בני אדם בזה אחר זה האחרון חייב — ה"נ האחרון חייב, ואי בבת אחת — כולן פטורין ממיתה, ד"כמיתת בעלים כך מיתת השור". וכיון דפטורין ממיתה, פטורין מכופר, למ"ד לקמן: "אין השור בסקילה, אין הבעלים משלמין כופר":
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:14:1.english: An ox belonging to two partners - He could not ask about two oxen belonging to two [different owners], because according to R. Yehudah ben Beteira, who says (Sanhedrin 78a) regarding [the case where] ten people struck him one after another [that] the last one is liable — here too, the last one is liable; and if [they gored] simultaneously, all of them are exempt from execution, because "as the death of the owner, so is the death of the ox." And since they are exempt from execution, they are exempt from ransom, according to the one who says later on: "[Where] the ox is not [subject] to stoning, the owners do not pay ransom."

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:15:1.hebrew: כופר אחד אמר רחמנא ולא ב' - ואע"ג דלגבי חטאת אמר בפ' המצניע (שבת דף צב: ושם.) גבי המוציא ככר לרה"ר, "והוציאו שנים חייבין", ומסתמא כל חד וחד חייב חטאת — התם, כיון דכל חד מיחייב אזדונו כרת, מיחייב נמי אשגגתו חטאת; ועוד, חטאת דלגבוה — אין להקפיד אי מביאין שתי חטאות, אבל כופר דלחבירו — למה ירויח זה במה שהשור לשנים:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:15:1.english: "The Merciful One states one ransom, and not two" - Even though regarding a sin-offering [the Mishnah] says in the chapter [entitled] Hamatzni'a (Shabbat 92b, and [in the Gemara] there) concerning one who carries out a loaf into the public domain, "and [if] two [people] carried it out, they are liable," and presumably each and every one is liable for a sin-offering — there, since each one is liable for karet for his intentional [transgression], he is also liable for a sin-offering for his unwitting [transgression]; and furthermore, [regarding] a sin-offering, which is for the Most High, there is no reason to object if they bring two sin-offerings; however, [regarding] ransom, which is [paid] to his fellow — why should this [person] profit from the fact that the ox belongs to two [partners]?

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:15:2.hebrew: כופר שלם אמר רחמנא ולא חצי כופר - דוקא לענין כופר, דכפרה היא, דמסתמא כפרה שלימה צריכא. אבל לענין התשלומין, אמר לקמן במרובה (בבא קמא דף עא:): "ה' בקר" — ואפילו ה' חצאי בקר, ו"שה" — אפילו מקצת שה דפ' אותו ואת בנו (חולין דף עט:), ו"דמו" — [אפילו] מקצת דמו דכיסוי הדם (שם דף פח.), וחצי מתנות דהזרוע (שם דף קלב.), ו"בכור" — ואפילו מקצת בכור דריש בכורות (דף ג. ושם.) — לא שייך לאתויי הכא. וההיא ד"חומש ולא חצי חומש" דפ' יש בכור (בכורות דף מח:) שייך טפי. והא דמשלם תם חצי כופר לר' יוסי הגלילי — היינו כופר שלם דידיה. וכן המית מי שחציו עבד וחציו בן חורין דהשולח (גיטין דף מב:), דמשלם חצי כופר ליורשים — היינו כופר שלם דידיה:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:15:2.english: "The Merciful One states a full ransom, and not half a ransom" - [This applies] specifically regarding ransom, since it is an atonement, for presumably a complete atonement is required. However, regarding payments, [the Gemara] says later in [chapter] Merubah (Bava Kamma 71b): "five oxen" — and even five half-oxen; and "a sheep" — even part of a sheep, of the chapter Oto Ve'et Beno (Chullin 79b); and "its blood" — [even] part of its blood, of [the chapter] Kisuy HaDam (ibid. 88a); and half-gifts, of [the chapter] HaZero'a (ibid. 132a); and "a firstborn" — even part of a firstborn, of the beginning of Bekhorot (3a, and there) — [all these] are not relevant to bring here. Whereas that [teaching] of "a fifth, and not half a fifth" of the chapter Yesh Bekhor (Bekhorot 48b) is more relevant [to cite here]. And that which a tam [an innocuous ox] pays half-ransom according to Rabbi Yose HaGelili — that is its full ransom. And similarly, [where an ox] killed someone who is half-slave and half-free, of [the chapter] HaShole'ach (Gittin 42b), where it pays half-ransom to the heirs — that is its full ransom.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:16:1.hebrew: חייבי כופר מאי - ביורשי הניזק עצמו מבעיא ליה, אם יכולין למשכנו:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:16:1.english: What [is the law regarding] those liable [to pay] ransom? - He is inquiring regarding the heirs of the injured party themselves, whether they can take a pledge from him.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:22:1.hebrew: ולימא ליה אי תם הוה משתלם מגופו - הך פרכא לית ליה לר"י דאמר צד תמות במקומה עומדת, וכן ההיא פירכא דהוה מערקנא ליה לאגמא; אבל ההיא פירכא דמודינא ומפטרי אתיא אף אליבא דר"י, דכיון דאייעד — לאו קנסא הוא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:22:1.english: And let him say to him: If it were innocuous, [the damage] would be paid from its body - This objection does not hold according to Rabbi Yehuda, who says [that] the innocuous aspect [of a forewarned ox] remains in its place, and likewise that [subsequent] objection, [namely,] "I would have driven it away to the marsh." However, that [other] objection, [namely,] "I would admit [it] and be exempt," applies even according to Rabbi Yehuda, because once it has become forewarned, [the payment] is not a fine.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:27:1.hebrew: לאו תורא בעית לשלומי - וא"ת: אי הוה תם, לא הוה משתלם אלא כמו שהשור שוה, והשתא משלם כל חצי נזק מהעלייה, אע"פ שאין השור שוה כל כך? וי"ל: דהשתא נמי לא משלם אלא בשויו של שור:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 40a:27:1.english: "Are you not required to pay [for] an ox?" - And if you ask: If it had been innocuous, [compensation] would only be paid according to what the ox is worth, whereas now he pays the entire half-damage from [his] superior-quality property, even though the ox is not worth that much? And one can answer: Now too, he only pays up to the value of the ox.
